# `silk/slice`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Allocation-free views of contiguous initialized elements.

## When to use
Use [`view`](#declaration-) to borrow a subrange of an existing slice without copying its elements.

## Details
Views retain the input lifetime. Bounds follow indexing: an invalid range traps.
An empty range at the end is valid, including for an empty input.

Import as `Slice` with `import silk.slice { Slice }`.

Public declarations: 1.

### Associated function `view`

```silk
pub fn view<T>(values: &[T], offset: usize, length: usize) -> &[T]
```

Borrows `length` elements starting at `offset`, without copying or allocating.

#### Details

The returned shared view cannot outlive the input. A zero-length view at the end is valid.

#### Gotchas

Traps if `offset` exceeds the input length or `length` exceeds the remaining range.
